The [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Your zodiac sun, moon and rising signs from your birth date and time. Enter your birth date and birth time (24-hour, e.g. 08:30) and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Find your zodiac sun sign, moon sign and rising sign from your birth date and time. The sun sign comes from your birth date and is the one most people know; the moon sign is calculated from the moon's position on that date; the rising sign is estimated from your birth time. This is astrology — entertainment, not science. The moon and rising signs are approximations: the real moon sign can differ by up to about a day near a sign boundary, and a true rising sign needs your exact birth place as well as the time.

## How to use the Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator

Start by picking your birth date, then typing or pasting your birth time (24-hour, e.g. 08:30). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause.

1. Enter your birth date — the sun and moon signs come from it.
2. Enter your birth time for the rising sign (leave it blank for sun and moon only).
3. Read your three signs — the moon and rising signs are labelled approximate.

## How it works

The [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) works straight from the values you enter: change an input and the result updates immediately, with no page reload and no waiting. Everything happens in your browser, so your entries never leave your device. Try it with a few different values and you will quickly get a feel for how the inputs move the result.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. Born 15 June 1990 at 8:30 AM: the sun sign is Gemini (May 21 – Jun 20), the moon sign is approximately Pisces, and the rising sign is approximately Cancer. Try the same figures in the [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Birth date: 1990-06-15, Birth time (24-hour, e.g. 08:30): 08:30), the [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) returns Sun sign: Gemini (May 21 – Jun 20), Moon sign: Pisces (approximate), Rising sign: Cancer (approximate — from birth time), Moon phase on that day: Last Quarter. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. ## What the three signs mean in astrology

In astrology the sun sign is said to describe your core self, the moon sign your emotional side, and the rising sign (ascendant) how you come across to others. The sun sign is exact from the date alone. The moon moves fast — about 13 degrees a day — so its sign depends on the exact day and can sit near a boundary. The rising sign changes about every two hours and depends on the birth place, so the time-based estimate here is rough by design.

## How the approximations work

The moon sign is calculated from the moon's position, anchored on the new moon of 6 January 2000 and advanced by its daily motion of about 13.18 degrees. The rising sign uses the popular rule that at about 6 AM the rising sign is the sun sign, advancing about one sign every two hours after that. Both are good enough for entertainment, and neither is precise enough for a serious astrological chart — that needs the exact time and place of birth.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- The sun sign is exact from the date; the moon and rising signs are approximate.
- Near a sign boundary, check the day before and after too.
- This is entertainment — it is not a scientific measurement.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is my zodiac sign?

It depends on your birth date — for example, 15 June is Gemini (May 21 – Jun 20). Enter your birth date and the calculator shows your sun, moon and rising signs. Try it with your own numbers in the [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What is a rising sign?

In astrology, the sign that was on the eastern horizon when you were born — said to describe how you come across. It changes about every two hours, so it needs your birth time. Try it with your own numbers in the [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Why is my moon sign approximate?

The moon moves about 13 degrees a day, so its sign depends on the exact time of day and can sit near a boundary. This calculator estimates from the date alone. Try it with your own numbers in the [Sun, Moon & Rising Sign Calculator](/sun-moon-rising-sign-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is astrology scientific?

No. Astrology is entertainment: controlled studies find no link between zodiac signs and personality. Treat the results as fun, not fact.
